operations.name: filter.apply
operations.description: Apply a destructive filter to the active layer (selection restricts it). Types: gaussian-blur {radius px}, sharpen {amount 0..3, radius px}, sharpen-more, sharpen-edges, unsharp-mask {amount percent 1..500, radius px, threshold 0..255}, noise {amount 0..1}, box-blur {radius px}, motion-blur {angle deg, distance px}, radial-blur {amount 1..100, method spin|zoom}, average, median {radius 1..8}, mosaic {cellSize px}, high-pass {radius px}, ripple {amount px, wavelength px}, twirl {angle deg}, spherize {amount -100..100}, wave {amplitude px, wavelength px}, zigzag {amount px, ridges}, polar-coordinates {mode rect-to-polar|polar-to-rect}, crystallize {cellSize px}, pointillize {cellSize px}, facet, fragment, despeckle, dust-and-scratches {radius px, threshold 0..255}, emboss {angle deg, height px, amount 0..5}, find-edges, solarize, trace-contour {level 0..255, edge lower|upper}, wind {method wind|blast|stagger, direction left|right}, clouds, difference-clouds, lens-flare {brightness percent 10..300, centerX 0..1, centerY 0..1}, fibers {variance 1..64, strength 1..64}, maximum {radius px}, minimum {radius px}, offset {dx px, dy px}, custom {kernel 25 numbers, scale, offset}. Pass params in "params".

operations.name: filter.blur_gallery
operations.description: Apply Blur Gallery to the active raster layer as one command. kind field uses pins [{x,y,radius}], iris uses ellipse handles, tilt-shift uses center/angle/sharp_width/feather/blur. Coordinates are document pixels.

operations.name: filter.displace
operations.description: Apply Distort > Displace to the active raster layer. params: scale_x/scale_y, placement stretch|tile, undefined_areas wrap|repeat-edge. map_source is {width,height,data}; data may be grayscale or RGBA bytes, using R for horizontal and G for vertical displacement.

operations.name: filter.gallery_apply
operations.description: Apply a Filter Gallery stack in order as one undoable command. stack is [{type, params}] using existing gallery-capable filters; smart objects receive one appended smart-filter stack command.

stack.description: Array of filter entries: { type, params }
